KPI Snapshot

Current week  |  comparing with previous week

Every KPI, trended across all available periods at the current Day/Week/Month granularity, for the Team/View-by/Engineers currently selected above.

Green/red direction flips per KPI to match standard ITSM convention (e.g. higher SLA%/FCR%/Compliance% is good; higher Escalated/Reopened%/Avg days is bad). “Total Assigned” is workload, not performance, so it's shaded blue by volume only. Arrows compare against the previous week; hover any cell for the exact figures. A dash means the KPI didn't apply to that engineer this week — not a zero. Click any KPI column header to sort. Use Team and Engineers above to focus the view — the summary and export follow your selection.

SLA Compliance by Period

Same 7 metrics as the reconciliation tables above. Resolution-based metrics (Resolution SLA — IM, Resolution SLA 3bd — SR Standard, Resolution Meeting EDOC) are grouped by when the ticket was resolved; the other 4 are grouped by when the ticket was created — matching the Team-Level Filters period selection above.
SLA Compliance by Creation Time

Same 7 metrics, same attribution, as the table above — the only difference is which period each ticket is bucketed under. Every metric here is grouped by when the ticket was created, including the 3 resolution-based metrics which the table above groups by when the ticket was resolved instead. A ticket created in one period but resolved in a later one shows up in its creation period here, and in its resolution period above — useful for asking "of what we took on in a given period, how did it turn out", rather than "what did we close out in a given period".

Computed live in your browser from the Call Dump export you upload — no other files needed; Team/Tower roll-ups, delegation SLA cutoffs, and the holiday calendar use this tool's built-in defaults. v4b rules: 1st Response, Resolution SLA (IM + SR-Standard), and EDOC-Shared use the platform-provided ack_sla_minutes/tat_sla_minutes/edoc_sla_minutes fields against a fixed master SLA table, with multi-tier violator attribution. Delegation SLA IM Medium/Low cutoff is 3 business days. See the Notes and Exclusions tab for full methodology detail. By Feature tab is not included (categorization not reconstructable from the raw export). This file is self-contained; charting via Chart.js and Excel export via SheetJS (both loaded from a CDN — no server, account, or install needed once opened).
